description: This file defines the API class MyClaimRequestAPI which handles operations related to 'My Claim Requests' in the OrangeHRM Claim module. It includes methods for creating, retrieving, and listing claim requests, along with validation rules and OpenAPI annotations for documentation.

classes.name: MyClaimRequestAPI
classes.description: API controller class for managing employee-specific claim request operations, including creation, retrieval, listing, and validation, with OpenAPI annotations for documentation.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles creation of a new claim request by delegating to the parent class implementation.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves details of a single claim request, delegating to the parent class.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all claim requests for the authenticated user, delegating to the parent class.

methods.name: isSelfByEmpNumber
methods.description: Checks if the provided employee number corresponds to the current authenticated user.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for creating claim requests.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for retrieving a specific claim request by ID.

methods.name: getClaimRequestSearchFilterParams
methods.description: Creates a new instance of ClaimRequestSearchFilterParams for filtering claim requests.

methods.name: getEndPointCollectionResult
methods.description: Formats the collection result for display, depending on the model type requested.

methods.name: setEmpNumbers
methods.description: Sets the employee numbers filter to only include the logged-in user's employee number.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Configures validation rules for listing claim requests, including sorting and pagination.
